# w.scrpt 0.1.0 RC30 checkpoint

Date: 2026-07-28

Worktree: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

## Scope

RC30 adds bounded read-only explicit Git commit inspection so commit hashes visible in log, file-history, blame, or external review can be inspected inside the same streamlined IDE surface.

- `:commit-info HASH`, `:commitinfo HASH`, `:show-commit HASH`, and `:git-show HASH` open Git Commit details.
- The command accepts only a 4-to-64-character hexadecimal commit id.
- Symbolic refs and option-like inputs such as `HEAD` or `--stat` are refused before Git runs.
- The view shows repository path, requested commit id, commit metadata, stat, and patch.
- The view is read-only and cannot edit source text.
- The command runs directly through the existing bounded Git runner, never through a shell.
- It does not stage, commit, switch, pull, push, reset, tag, or discard working-tree content.
- README and the iPad QA matrix document the new commit-inspection route.

## Proof boundary

This checkpoint is locally verified on the host Rust/PTY path. It is not a real iPad Magic Keyboard, Blink Shell, mosh, SSH, tmux, clipboard, touch, reconnect, or real language-server proof. Those remain manual QA gates in `docs/IPAD_BLINK_QA.md`.
